Crisp detailed chibi pixel-art, warm shaded color clusters and dark contours. All joints connected naturally, no cracks. Rows 1-2 male 12 frames, rows 3-4 female same 12 frames. Columns: head with neck; torso complete including pelvis/clothing but no head arms legs; full left arm shoulder to hand WITH its weapon if held; full right arm shoulder to hand WITH its weapon if held; full left leg hip to foot; full right leg hip to foot. Draw parts fully including hidden cloth/skin behind joints and rounded overlapping joint caps. Center each isolated part, neutral pose. Maintain identity, clothing palette and anatomy across all cells; no baked checkerboard.
